degree_rationale: How the living soul has only the sun and moon as gates of rest — no other power's gate is open to her except the luminaries; analogously the Land of Light becomes final receiver. Illumines the natural pathway of soul-rest.
direction_rationale: Wisdom illumining what the soul's available pathways are — the bright open gate amid closed ones.
grand_man_function: Natural soul-pathway illumination — the only open gates for the soul.
title: How souls in trial rise to the luminaries for rest before salvation
